name: Shagobeth
description: A skeletal lich king who rules from a frozen crypt and calls the dead to defend the kingdom that erased his name.
biography:
In the last winter of his reign, Shagobeth ordered the royal granaries opened. His council sealed the doors, took his crown, and buried him beneath the palace with a handful of grain. The next spring, they chiseled his name off the city gates.

Centuries later, a thaw flooded the crypt. Shagobeth rose and found the palace gone and a market standing in its place. He learned the names of the children who had starved that winter, then began calling them back as his subjects. The living descendants have asked him to let their families rest. He still sets a place for each of the dead at his table.
